trigger: Batch-24 row-count telemetry showed that generation is healthy and memory-safe but that all four cells may slightly exceed the original 90-minute pod lease.
decision_basis: Only row counts, wall time, process state, and resource telemetry were inspected. Response content, cell scores, and aggregate primary outcomes remain sealed.

cost_amendment.rationale: A bounded continuation is cheaper than discarding completed matched cells and provisioning a replacement run.

unchanged: model, model revision, adapter bytes, task universe, seeds, greedy decoding, parser, prompts, maximum turns, maximum tokens, controller, scorer, four cells, rollouts, batch size, estimands, bootstrap, and claim boundaries
validity: Rows are resumed by exact task_id and rollout_index keys in the runner. Completed cells are accepted only when their receipt status is completed and row count is exactly 288.
